blockers.reason: K2PV-QRM-002 preserves C1/C2/C3 in prose but does not machine-bind the exact three-lane estimand graph in the plan record.
V02 requires versioned+hashed mapping generators, but the future freeze fields do not yet have a canonical machine schema for ref/version/hash/seed semantics.
Representation parity is a protocol clause only; no executable materializer binds shared world-variable/symbol/feature/rule/prediction manifests.
closure_requires: shared-manifest hash equality across all lanes

blockers.reason: Comparator, bridge and candidate generator fields exist, but no executable deterministic generator interface is registered.
closure_requires: three frozen generator implementations or one lane-parameterized deterministic implementation

blockers.reason: Equal role/branch/rule-trace/information/tool budgets are declared but not machine-enforced.
Neutral labels, frozen lane order and no cross-lane intermediate output are not backed by an isolated execution runner.
closure_requires: unblind only after all prediction freezes

blockers.reason: ABSTAIN retention and coverage-penalized scoring are declared but have no P2-specific executable scorer.
A reproducibility_fixture_hash field exists, but there is no pipeline that generates and replays an exact pre-Batch fixture.
The generic Batch manifest binder validates manifest identity but does not serialize or validate all P2-specific freeze fields and parity invariants.

generic_infrastructure_reuse.scope: canonical Batch manifest binding, plan/model identity, research_only and outcome_data_used=false
generic_infrastructure_reuse.not_sufficient_for: P2 role-map parity, generator determinism, blinding, denominator scoring or P2 freeze serialization

non_claims: All green CI at the audited parent proves contract consistency, not P2 execution readiness.
This audit does not create a Batch or Freeze.
This audit does not validate QRM-H1.
No source or empirical credit is upgraded by identifying implementation blockers.
